annotations.exact_quote: A method for dealing with probe data along with conventional detector data to estimate traffic states is proposed.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文以探针车数据、常规检测器数据以及交通状态/旅行时间为实际研究数据对象，属于交通数据对象。

annotations.exact_quote: Estimated states were updated with information from both stationary detectors and probe vehicles.
annotations.reason_zh: 将固定检测器与探针车两类互补观测变量联合用于同一交通状态估计，符合多视图/多观测联合利用的数据设定。

annotations.exact_quote: The probe data were integrated into the observation equation of the Kalman filter, in which state equations are represented by a macroscopic traffic-flow model.
annotations.reason_zh: 使用Kalman滤波的状态方程与观测方程进行概率状态估计，属于通过概率模型进行后验状态推断的方法。
